actions.body: The synthesis of recent literature (Krishnan, 2025) reveals a transition from traditional static cognitive architectures to dynamic agentic frameworks that incorporate explicit self-correction loops. While earlier models relied on predefined rule-based architectures, modern agentic approaches integrate iterative feedback mechanisms. This evolution addresses prior reasoning bottlenecks identified in older surveys, though systemic limits in autonomous error attribution remain a challenge.
actions.lede: Analysis of how current cognitive architectures handle internal error detection and reasoning self-correction.
actions.reason: Revision reflects the updated integration of self-correction mechanisms found in March 2025 literature.
